name: Churches of Moldavia
description: Eight Orthodox churches scattered across the green hills of Suceava County in northern Romania, built between the late 1400s and late 1500s, are famous for the paintings that cover their outer walls. Saints, biblical scenes and entire religious stories glow in rich colours on every facade. At Suceviţa, the walls are painted inside and out, including the only known depiction of St John Climacus's ladder.
